children: STOCKS FALL AS OIL, BOND YIELDS CLIMB

Wall Street's three major indexes went into reverse on Tuesday as oil prices rallied and 10-year Treasury yields eyed their fifth straight day of gains, touching their highest point since January 2025.
U.S. crude oil prices rallied about 3% as a resumption in fighting between the United States and Iran in the Middle East renewed fears of supply disruptions from the oil-producing region.
On the data front, U.S. manufacturing activity eased in August after strong growth in the prior month, with new orders slowing and input prices remaining high amid persistent supply-chain strains.
Meanwhile, Federal Reserve Governor Michael Barr said on Tuesday that if inflation does not cool quickly, it will be time for the U.S. central bank to increase interest rates.

leading losses with a 1.7% drop while technology
, supported by rising oil prices, was the strongest gainer, up about 1%.
